judgments.en_span: The Group has been providing supply chain management services to customers in the building materials sector since 2019 and has relied on third-party service providers for freight forwarding and warehousing.
judgments.zh_span: 本集團自二零一九年起一直向建築材料行業的客戶提供供應鏈管理服務，並依賴第三方服務供應商提供貨運代理及倉儲服務。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey identical meaning about the Group's supply chain services and reliance on third-party providers.

judgments.en_span: The Board believes that the Acquisition will allow the Group to internalise these functions, reduce its logistics costs and broaden the range of services offered to its existing customers.
judgments.zh_span: 董事會相信，收購事項將使本集團能夠將該等職能內部化、降低其物流成本，並擴大向現有客戶提供的服務範圍。
judgments.explanation: Both passages express the Board's belief about the Acquisition's benefits with identical meaning.

judgments.en_span: The Target recorded growth in revenue of approximately 15.9% for the year ended 31 December 2025 and maintains long-standing relationships with a number of shipping lines and airline cargo agents.
judgments.zh_span: 目標公司截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度錄得收益增長約15.9%，並與多家船公司及航空貨運代理保持長期合作關係。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the Target's revenue growth and relationships with shipping and airline cargo agents identically.

judgments.en_span: Following Completion, the Group may consider further acquisitions in the logistics sector.
judgments.zh_span: 完成後，本集團將考慮於物流行業進行進一步收購。
judgments.explanation: EN uses 'may consider' (conditional/permissive) while ZH uses '將考慮' (will consider), indicating stronger commitment.

judgments.en_span: Any such acquisition will be subject to the applicable requirements of the Listing Rules and a separate announcement will be made by the Company as and when appropriate.
judgments.zh_span: 任何該等收購將須遵守上市規則的適用規定，本公司將於適當時候另行刊發公告。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey identical meaning about future acquisitions being subject to Listing Rules and requiring announcements.

judgments.en_span: As at the date of this announcement, the Company has not identified any specific target and has not entered into any agreement, arrangement or understanding in respect of any such acquisition.
judgments.zh_span: 於本公告日期，本公司尚未物色任何特定目標，亦未就任何該等收購訂立任何協議、安排或諒解。
judgments.explanation: Both passages state identically that no specific target has been identified and no agreements have been entered into.

judgments.en_span: The Directors (other than the independent non-executive Directors, whose views will be set out in the circular after considering the advice of the Independent Financial Adviser) are of the view that the terms of the Agreement are on normal commercial terms, fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and the Shareholders as a whole.
judgments.zh_span: 董事（獨立非執行董事除外，彼等的意見將於考慮獨立財務顧問的意見後載於通函內）認為，本協議的條款屬一般商業條款，公平合理，並符合本公司及股東的整體利益。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the Directors' views on the Agreement's terms with identical meaning and scope.

judgments.en_span: Mr. Chan Wai Kwong, who is interested in the Acquisition through his interest in the Vendor, has abstained from voting on the relevant Board resolution.
judgments.zh_span: 陳偉光先生因其於賣方的權益而於收購事項中擁有權益，故已就相關董事會決議案放棄投票。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey that Mr. Chan abstained from voting due to his interest in the Vendor.

judgments.en_span: Save as disclosed above, none of the Directors has a material interest in the Acquisition.
judgments.zh_span: 除上文所披露者外，概無董事於收購事項中擁有重大權益。
judgments.explanation: Both passages state identically that no other Directors have material interests in the Acquisition.
